authority.wireTopicDecision: The M3-T01 tenant/resource event-routing matrix is canonical for Realtime wire topics. Legacy org/page/job forms are server-side logical references, never browser-constructed Realtime topics.
authority.authorization: A subscription descriptor is issued only by an authenticated server after it rechecks the current ACTIVE membership and any resource ownership. A topic string is never authority.
authority.durableTruth: Realtime is advisory delivery only. PostgreSQL-backed authorized reads are the durable source of truth.

rules: A normal browser session token is not a channel credential and must be denied by the Realtime policy.
Only the same-origin server may sign or obtain the scoped transport token after rechecking current authorization. The signing material never enters browser code, logs, fixtures or Git.
The browser receives a descriptor after authorization; it must not concatenate tenant, resource, page, job or subject identifiers into a topic.
A descriptor becomes unusable after its authorizationEpoch changes, the membership is no longer ACTIVE, or the session cannot be refreshed.
Logical references may be used by server routing code only; they are not Realtime topics.
The M3-T01 event-contract job namespace has no active Realtime route in v0.1 and must not be subscribed to by a browser.

channels.owner: current ACTIVE membership for the resource owner
current ACTIVE membership for the resource owner
channels.onEvent: render ephemeral collaborator state only; never derive durable content or correctness
channels.writeAuthority: The browser sends the bounded intent only to the same-origin M3-T03 adapter. It has no direct INSERT authority on realtime.messages; the server validates and emits the canonical minimal presence state.

excludedEventTypes.reason: Notification delivery is owned by the later M5 notification task.
Outbox state is internal durable-worker evidence, not a browser subscription.

lifecycle.onSubscribe: Immediately refetch the authorized durable projection; a successful join never proves the projection is current.
lifecycle.onDuplicateOrOutOfOrder: Coalesce to one authorized durable refetch. Do not mutate browser truth from advisory event ordering.
lifecycle.afterReconnectExhausted: Enter DEGRADED_REFETCH_REQUIRED and stop automatic retries until a new server-issued descriptor is obtained.
lifecycle.onTokenRefresh: Refresh the private-channel token before rejoin. On refresh failure, close the channel and enter AUTH_REFRESH_REQUIRED.
lifecycle.onMembershipRemovalOrExpiry: Close the channel, discard the descriptor, refetch only through the same-origin authorization boundary, and do not retry with the stale descriptor.
lifecycle.onTransportOutage: Expose delivery degradation and preserve durable state; recovery starts with a fresh authorized refetch.

safety.safePayloadSource: The M3-T01 event envelope safePayload allowlist remains authoritative for broadcasts.
safety.rateControl: Presence updates represent slow state changes only. Cursor and per-keystroke updates are forbidden.
prohibitions: No browser-originated broadcast for publication, workflow, job progress or outbox state.
No browser direct write to realtime.messages, including Presence.

limitations: This contract defines no provider configuration, hosted Supabase project, server signing key, browser hook, server adapter or live Realtime evidence.
M3-DB01 alone owns realtime.messages policy DDL; M3-T03 only consumes that policy through adapters and conformance tests.
